dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: The target proposition universally characterizes exactly which real-valued functions are the underlying function of a bundled LocalDef002 object: precisely those satisfying the five displayed half-line/asymptotic conditions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This dependency is the proposition being translated and supplies its universal quantifier and equivalence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: A bundled type whose constructor data, as exposed by D004, consist of a real-valued function together with nonnegativity, convexity, monotonicity, zero-at-zero, and divergence-at-positive-infinity witnesses.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of the existential witness on the left side of the equivalence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection/coercion taking a bundled LocalDef002 object to its underlying function from the reals to the reals; therefore ψ.toFun = f is equality on the whole real line.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the existential clause assert exact whole-function equality, not merely agreement on nonnegative inputs.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor packages any function satisfying all five stated conditions into a LocalDef002 object, explaining the reverse direction of the equivalence.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It shows that the five conditions are exactly the data needed to construct the existential witness.

dependency_coverage.name: Algebra.id
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the canonical real algebra over itself used to interpret real scalar multiplication in the convexity predicate; it introduces no extra mathematical hypothesis.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the scalar action in ConvexOn as ordinary multiplication of real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Algebra.toSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts scalar multiplication from the real algebra structure, so the affine combinations in convexity are the ordinary real scalar combinations.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines how the coefficients a and b act on x, y, f(x), and f(y) in the convexity inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: And

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: None of the five defining properties is optional or merely an alternative.

dependency_coverage.name: CommSemiring.toSemiring

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is infrastructure for real affine arithmetic in ConvexOn and does not alter the proposition's logical scope.

dependency_coverage.name: ConvexOn
dependency_coverage.meaning: Requires [0,∞) to be a convex domain and requires f(a x + b y) ≤ a f(x) + b f(y) for x,y in [0,∞) and real a,b ≥ 0 with a+b=1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the precise non-strict Jensen-convexity condition on the nonnegative half-line.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Expresses exact equality of the bundled underlying function with f and the condition f(0)=0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes both identifications propositional equalities, including extensional equality of functions.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Quantifies a bundled witness ψ whose complete underlying real function is f.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The left side asks only for at least one such bundle and does not assert uniqueness.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter.Tendsto
dependency_coverage.meaning: Expresses convergence of f along inputs tending to +∞ to outputs tending to +∞.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires eventual passage above every real output threshold for all sufficiently large real inputs.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter.atTop
dependency_coverage.meaning: On the ordered reals, atTop means arbitrarily large values: for every real output threshold, sufficiently large real inputs have output above that threshold.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Using atTop for both domain and codomain specifies the two-sided notation f(x)→+∞ as x→+∞.

dependency_coverage.name: Iff

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The proposition is an exact characterization rather than only a necessary or sufficient implication.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All order comparisons in the claim permit equality.

dependency_coverage.name: MonotoneOn
dependency_coverage.meaning: Requires that whenever 0 ≤ a ≤ b, one has f(a) ≤ f(b); thus 'increasing' here means nondecreasing on [0,∞), not strictly increasing.

binders: A universally quantified function f : ℝ → ℝ.
conclusions: Existence of a LocalDef002 object with underlying function f is equivalent to the conjunction of nonnegativity, convexity, nondecreasingness, f(0)=0, and divergence to +∞.
mathematical_definitions: Convexity and monotonicity are restricted to [0,∞); Tendsto atTop atTop is the limit f(x)→+∞ as x→+∞.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every function f : ℝ → ℝ, there exists a bundled object ψ of type LocalDef002 whose underlying function ψ.toFun is exactly f if and only if all of the following hold: f(x) ≥ 0 for every x ≥ 0; f is convex on [0,∞); f is nondecreasing on [0,∞); f(0)=0; and f(x) tends to +∞ as x tends to +∞.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The nonnegativity, convexity, and monotonicity conditions are imposed only on [0,∞); f may have arbitrary values and behavior on negative inputs, except insofar as equality ψ.toFun=f records those values in the bundle.
MonotoneOn uses non-strict monotonicity, so the statement does not require f to be strictly increasing.
Tendsto f atTop atTop is an unbounded-limit condition as the real input tends to +∞; it is not merely unboundedness along a subsequence.
The proposition imposes no explicit continuity, strict positivity for positive arguments, measurability, or finiteness condition beyond f being real-valued.
The displayed nonnegativity condition is logically redundant given nondecreasingness on [0,∞) and f(0)=0, but it is nevertheless explicitly encoded.
There is no evident vacuity: [0,∞) is nonempty, and the equivalence follows from the exposed constructor/projection representation of LocalDef002.
ambiguities: D002 is exposed only as an inductive Type rather than with a full eliminator/uniqueness account; the supplied constructor data determine existence of a bundle but do not by themselves state proof-irrelevance or uniqueness of bundled witnesses.
